comments.snippet:
Thanks for the report, @bruste77 — this one tells a very clear story.

**What happened:** your crash is

> `MissingMethodException: Method not found: 'Void BrightIdeasSoftware.ObjectListView.SetSmallImageList(System.Windows.Forms.ImageList)'`

`SetSmallImageList` is a method that exists in **this fork's** bundled `ObjectListView.dll`. The exception means the `ObjectListView.dll` sitting next to your `mRemoteNG.exe` is an **older copy** that doesn't have it — i.e. the Portable package was unpacke...

comments.author: bruste77
comments.snippet: Actually I didn't use the portable version but the msi, however I uninstalled the msi, deleted the folder from program files, installed latest NB and the issue is not reproduced anymore. So this bug can be closed

notes: MissingMethodException SetSmallImageList = stale ObjectListView.dll after portable upgrade-in-place (same habit as #122; pin 052f1f4c5 lets old DLL bind but fork-added method missing). Replied: clean extract + confirm
